newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index jumps in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index jumps in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index jumped 164.5 points or 5.2 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries index closed 2.48 percent higher. Changes, in percent:
Dec 20 Dec 13 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The index jumped last week as strong speculation returned to the small resources sector, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
A favourable tone saw gains outnumber falls by a ratio of two to one.

Arboyne NL jumped 12 cents to 39 cents on an upgrade from the Nonoc nickel project in the Philippines and Tanganyika Gold NL moved 9.0 cents higher to 32.5 cents after the release of significant drill results from its Mawe Meru project in Tanzania.
But the star performer of the week was Summit Gold NL, up 39 cents to 60 cents, on uranium exploration success in Queensland following on from gold encouragement in New Zealand.
Gawler Craton stocks also improved. Goldstream Mining NL was up 14 cents to 61 cents, Equinox Resources NL up 17 cents to 85 cents and Helix Resources NL up 40 cents to A$3.50.
Falls included Kurnalpi Gold NL, off 3.5 cents to 20 cents, Acclaim Exploration NL, off 1.1 cents to 5.8 cents, and Gondwana Resources NL, down 0.5 cents to 3.9 cents.
